object.definition: The public compact convex set $W\subset\mathbb R^d$ has Euclidean diameter at most $D$. Losses are $\eta$-exp-concave on $W$ and satisfy $\|\nabla f_t(w)\|_2\le G$. Arbitrary admissible sequences are allowed. $$e^{-\eta f_t(\cdot)}\ \text{on }W\text{ is concave}.$$

operation.query_signature: Submit the final action $w_t\in W$, then receive only $\nabla f_t(w_t)$. Full-function feedback and additional value or gradient evaluations at other points are unavailable. Exact Mahalanobis projection onto the public set is allowed, with arithmetic cost $C_{\mathrm{proj}}(d)$ per projection. The learner is causal and feasible. Inputs $d,T,D,G,\eta,W$ are public; comparator path budget $P_T^{(2)}$ is hidden. Received feedback may be stored and reused computationally. No unrevealed historical information or extra queries to exhausted samples are available; any within-round full-function or common-sample access must be explicit.

protocols.past_requery: History may be stored. New information from old samples or past rounds is unavailable unless the native interface explicitly permits it.
steps: In each round, the learner first commits to its final action $w_t\in W$ and then receives only $\nabla f_t(w_t)$. Full-function feedback and additional value or gradient evaluations at other points are unavailable.
Exact Mahalanobis projection onto the public set is allowed. The arithmetic cost of one projection is $C_{\mathrm{proj}}(d)$.
The learner is causal and remains in the domain. Public inputs are $d,T,D,G,\eta,W$; comparator path budget $P_T^{(2)}$ is not supplied.

Received feedback may be stored and reused in computation. Unrevealed information cannot be requested from past rounds, and consumed random samples cannot receive additional queries. Current-round exceptions are limited to the explicitly supplied full-function access or same-sample two-point interface.
